scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Welcome!
I've been wondering when you would arrive.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
You are here!
The people from other families all have taken their seats.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
By the way.........
After I left the Banquet Hall
....No, never mind.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Nothing good can be heard if we keep them waiting for any longer. Let's get going.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere is a seat left next to Lord Richard. It must be the seat reserved for an observer.^000000

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Well, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text:
What is going on...
We shall leave this place first.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Is everyone all right...

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
All seem well.
...I shall get going. The brothers don't look so good.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Phew, let's get out of here.
Sis, let's get out!
Nyhill, you should come with us!

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Other people will get out on their own!

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: ...There seems to be no one dead.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Peter is in a critical condition.
...Would you mind fighting against the intruder for us?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
....
.... ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is missing...
Terra Gloria?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It is the crown passed down in the palace of Rune-Midgarts.
It means more than an ordinary crown.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Has it been taken by them?
What on earth...!

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: What is hidden here is not known to anyone... Except the seven royal families...!

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Does it mean...
...Well, first things first, There are things to find out.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Let's get out of here now.
There is much left for use to find out.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Whoever left here, clear out with the wounded near you!
The Room of Consciousness will be closed for a while!

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Peter has been wounded.
We need to move him fast.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I'll see you out there.
You can leave through the door you have entered.
Let's meet at the Past Memories of the Royal Family.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: ...This... Is all... My fault...

We should watch the Ritual of Blessing.
Don't get out now.
